# Data Source: postgresql_schema

Retrieves information about a PostgreSQL schema. [PostgreSQL documentation](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/ddl-schemas.html)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "postgresql_schema" "myschema" {
  name = "myschema"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the schema to query.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the schema
- `owner` (String) The role that owns the schema.
